The following events took place in '''40 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]] and [[Telos Holocron]] were rediscovered by the [[New Jedi Order]].
*[[Tionne Solusar]] [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force|updated]] the Great Holocron with data from recent history.
*The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] launched a punitive [[Operation Roundabout|military strike]] against [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
*The [[Sepan Civil War]] resumed.
*[[Lumiya]] and her [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]], which she founded after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] [[4 ABY/Legends|36 years prior]], became active again and began to openly affect [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs.
*[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] became a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] under Lumiya.
*The [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] was founded.
*[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] were marked for [[Death/Legends|death]].
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] opposed the Galactic Alliance.
*The [[Five Worlds]] were reorganized into the [[Confederation]].
*A new [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] between the Galactic Alliance and Corellia started.
*While on a mission to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], [[Ben Skywalker]] discovered the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Sith training ship]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], which instigated the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|emergence]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in [[41 ABY]].
*[[Solo-Niathal coup|Galactic Alliance Chief of State coup]].
*Ben Skywalker [[Mission to Vulpter|assassinated]] [[Dur Gejjen]].
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] wife, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] was killed in a [[Skirmish on Kavan|duel]] with their nephew, Jacen Solo.
*Lumiya was [[Duel on Terephon|killed]] by Luke Skywalker.
*Jacen Solo proclaimed himself Darth Caedus, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].
*The Galactic Alliance Guard [[Battle of Ossus (Second Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
*Deposed former Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] committed suicide by throwing himself onto [[Ben Skywalker's lightsaber]].
*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)|left]] the Galactic Alliance, forming the [[Jedi Coalition]].
*During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], Darth Caedus ordered his [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|ship]], the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], to use its [[long-range turbolaser]] batteries to set fire to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
*[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] joined the Confederation.
*[[Alema Rar]] was [[Skirmish at The Home|killed]] by [[Jagged Fel]] on Lumiya's former headquarters, [[The Home]].
*Much of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] joined the Confederation.
*[[Centerpoint Station]] was fired, [[Battle of the rendezvous point|destroying]] the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]].
*Centerpoint Station was [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] by Jedi insurgents.
